turns.tutor:
Hello! Look at this example. I have oranges, and I can count them: one, two, three. So I ask: "How many oranges do you have?"
Rule: use "many" with things you can count.
Right: "How many oranges do you have?" Wrong: "How much oranges do you have?"
Now you try. Write much or many: How ___ bottles are there?
